name: NOVALINERS ADJUDICATION SCHEMA v0.1
note: Tahap 3 langkah 5 — adjudication schema + ledger (contract FINAL: internal-docs §6, gelombang 5-11, lock owner 26 Sep 2026). Deklaratif mengikuti pola requirement_schema.json; di-enforce oleh ontology/adjudication/validate_adjudication.py. INVARIANT TERKUNCI: (1) totalitas rule_evaluation — no_decisive = komplemen definisional, all-false dilarang; (2) D-A1c exclusivity — sufficient AND partial = INVALID, ditolak validator, bukan diselesaikan precedence; (3) PROPOSED != VERIFIED != ADJUDICATION — tiga objek terpisah struktural (acceptance criterion Tahap 3); (4) verification_method + verified hidup di VERIFIED mapping, BUKAN di ADJUDICATION result (D-A2); (5) ledger HANYA untuk adjudication sah — evaluation anomaly di channel terpisah (D-A1d); (6) UNKNOWN-by-absence: ketiadaan entry != entry berstatus UNKNOWN (INV-9).

proposed_mapping.description: Usulan evidence->requirement dari semantic mapper (LLM boleh) — BUKAN evidence, BUKAN authoritative (§6.7). Objek TERPISAH dari verified_mapping dan adjudication (acceptance criterion Tahap 3).

proposed_by.note: identitas mapper (mis. 'llm:mapper-v1') — proposal tanpa asal tak auditabel

verified_mapping.description: Hasil verifikasi ATAS proposed mapping (D-A2 LOCKED). verification_method + verified hidup DI SINI — DILARANG di adjudication result. Structural (opsi A) = prasyarat semua jalur, BUKAN anggota enum: gagal structural = malformed input, ditolak sebelum masuk sini.

evidence_refs.note: ref wajib menunjuk evidence yang BENAR-BENAR ADA di Universal State (ref integrity, §6.6)

verified.note: false -> evidence TIDAK diadmit (degradation rule) — consumer jatuh UNKNOWN, bukan status salah

adjudication_input.description: Kontrak I/O §6.2 — dua sumber read-only + waktu evaluasi.

evidence_refs.note: hanya evidence dari VERIFIED mapping verified=true (Admitted Evidence Set)

evaluation_time.note: horizon penilaian evidence — BERBEDA dari adjudicated_at

rule_evaluation.description: Evaluasi SEMUA cabang (bukan label singular). Invariant: totalitas (no_decisive = komplemen; all-false dilarang) + D-A1c exclusivity (sufficient AND partial = INVALID — objek seperti ini DITOLAK validator dan TIDAK PERNAH jadi adjudication output).

no_decisive.note: true TEPAT KETIKA tiga lainnya false (totalitas)

conflict_object.description: D-A1a — dua sisi tercatat; bool terlalu tipis (§6.2). Wajib lengkap KEDUA sisi saat conflict terdeteksi. D-A1c menjamin present_evidence_refs selalu tepat merujuk SATU cabang aktif (sufficient XOR partial).

adjudication_output.description: VALUE + record hasil adjudication SAH (boundary §6.1). DILARANG: evidence baru, tulis-ke-state, status di luar 4-enum, verification_method/verified (milik VERIFIED mapping).

ledger_entry.description: Append-only adjudication ledger (§6.4) — store TERPISAH dari Universal State (RR8; preseden store/nba.py + drift.py). HANYA berisi adjudication SAH — bukan bukti kegagalan konstruksi rule (itu anomaly channel).

evaluation_anomaly.description: D-A1d — catatan kegagalan konstruksi rule (mis. S∧P invalid) di channel TERPISAH dari ledger. Bukan RequirementStatus, bukan adjudication result, bukan conflict. TIDAK memblokir pipeline.

invariants.AD1: rule_evaluation total — no_decisive TEPAT KETIKA sufficient=partial=contradicting=false; all-false ditolak
invariants.AD2: D-A1c exclusivity — sufficient AND partial = INVALID; validator tolak (bukan precedence)
invariants.AD3: conflict (D-A1a) = (sufficient OR partial) AND contradicting; conflict object wajib dua sisi saat conflict
invariants.AD4: resolusi D-A1b: S->PRESENT, P->PARTIAL (hanya mode=PARTIAL, RR11), no_decisive->UNKNOWN, C tanpa S/P->ABSENT, conflict->UNKNOWN
invariants.AD5: status = fungsi murni (rule, evidence_set, evaluation_time) — recompute, tanpa sticky (§6.4)
invariants.AD6: ledger append-only, store terpisah dari Universal State (RR8) — hanya adjudication sah
invariants.AD7: evaluation anomaly = channel terpisah — bukan status, bukan adjudication result, bukan conflict (D-A1d)
invariants.AD8: PROPOSED != VERIFIED != ADJUDICATION — tiga objek terpisah struktural (acceptance criterion Tahap 3)
invariants.AD9: verification_method enum tertutup + verified: bool di VERIFIED mapping saja (D-A2); verified=false -> tidak diadmit -> UNKNOWN by absence
invariants.AD10: boundary §6.1 — adjudicator read-only: tidak menciptakan evidence, tidak menulis Universal State
